text: The programs feature a replenishable contingent facility and the first city-level parametric insurance scheme in Southeast Asia. They promote voluntary city participation with budget-funded premiums and a scale-up pathway for city involvement. The programs also emphasize gender, disability, and social inclusion (GEDSI) integration and are anchored in national PFM reforms.
